policy: Manual assertion review only. References and matching names never establish passing behavior. An empty dimension is unreviewed. Executed outcomes live in the separate source-bound evidence report.

F1.test: language defaults distinguish definition caller and formal environments
F1.checks: Exact JSON distinguishes definition/caller scope, forward defaults, positional/reordered names and interleaved required/optional formals.

F2.test: language explicit arguments override lazy defaults and ignore recursive defaults
F2.checks: Six explicit sources return 42 without demanding recursive or error-valued arguments/defaults.

F3.test: language defaults cache once per call and share dependent parameters
F3.checks: Native counter is two after two demanded calls and remains two after two unused defaults.

F4.test: language invalid binding executes no argument default or body callbacks
F4.checks: Four parse-valid missing/unknown/duplicate-positional-named/extra calls fail at evaluation with no native argument/default/body execution.

F5.test: language statics traverse unused defaults bodies and named arguments
F5.checks: Six invalid unused or overridden defaults/bodies/call sites are rejected during parse, without evaluation.

F6.test: language method defaults retain late self and lexical super
F6.checks: Original/derived method defaults select late self and the method layer's super independently.

O1.test: language object keys exclude new self locals and comprehension self
O1.checks: Six parse-only key-scope rejections plus one exact JSON control separate outer key self from inner value self.

O2.test: language inherited fields separate late self super root and original objects
O2.checks: Exact arrays distinguish final self, super-field self, immutable originals, root $ and nested self.

O3.test: language inherited assertions use final self for access and manifestation
O3.checks: One repaired-base success and four assertion errors on derived/visible/hidden access or manifestation.

O4.test: language manifestation checks assertion only objects recursively
O4.checks: Four recursive assertion-only manifestation errors and exact lazy shape/hidden/ignored-argument controls.

O5.test: language assertions cache checks and do not force messages or failed fields
O5.checks: Repeated fields check once, true assertion message runs zero times, false assertion blocks selected native payload.

O6.test: language visibility inheritance controls JSON output and direct access
O6.checks: All nine separator pairs compare manifested object and direct selected value; hidden overridden function is omitted.

O7.test: language JSON conversion rejects demanded nested functions and errors
O7.checks: Four function manifestations are Type errors, three demanded error expressions are Runtime errors, hidden function body stays uncalled.

S1.test: duplicate formal parameters fail statically before any invocation
S1.checks: Seven duplicate declaration forms, including unused functions, reject at Program creation.

I1.test: imported free variables cannot capture caller locals
I1.checks: Parse resolves nothing; forced imported free x rejects in dependency file after exactly one resolver read.

I2.test: unused imports never resolve even when the target would fail parsing
I2.checks: Six unused local/branch/argument/default/hidden/array imports execute zero resolver calls.

I3.test: import syntax and statics are checked only when the import is forced
I3.checks: Same parsed entry skips invalid dependency then separately observes Syntax/Static errors only after demand, with dependency location and entry context.

IDX.test: P0 indices require integers before conversion for arrays and Unicode strings
IDX.checks: Ten fractional/huge/empty/out-of-bounds errors and integral/Unicode controls, with invalid index preceding lazy payload.

SLICE.test: P0 slicing defers array indexing and keeps strings strict
SLICE.checks: Six expected slice results and three forced-index failures distinguish lazy array slices and strict string slices.

TYPE.test: foundation type returns every documented tag
TYPE.checks: One array compares all seven explicit type tags.

TYPELAZY.test: foundation type and isNumber inspect no nested payload assertion or function
assertions: callback: _ => fail("type reflection called native function")
TYPELAZY.checks: Outer type inspection avoids error payloads/assertions/defaults/body and cannot invoke registered native function.

CRLF.test: text blocks preserve interior and consecutive CRLF blank lines
CRLF.checks: Byte assertions retain interior/consecutive CRLF blank lines; no inference about all string lexing.

CHOMP.test: text-block chomp removes the complete final CRLF
CHOMP.checks: Final CRLF chomp is checked as exact UTF-8 bytes, not a visually equivalent string.

R1.test: recursive local groups bind forward references and mutually recursive functions
R1.checks: forms_value asserts exact JSON through parsed source and exported AST: forward/mutual recursion, shadowing and unused divergent/error bindings.

R2.test: duplicate local groups and sibling scope fail statically before unused execution
R2.checks: Eleven source cases reject at creation: duplicate local groups/functions/object locals/empty comprehension locals, duplicate literal fields, inaccessible sibling/later/outside variables.

R3.test: recursive local aliases share one demanded initializer and skip unused ones
R3.checks: Four alias demands share one native local initializer; the unused local callback is not executed.

R4.test: recursive object local aliases rebind final self and keep lexical super
R4.checks: Parsed source and exported AST distinguish original/derived/original results for forward object-local aliases using final self and lexical super.

C1.test: comprehension domains shadow sequentially and preserve Cartesian order
assertions: local x=['a','b']; {[x]:x for x in x}
C1.checks: forms_value checks exact Cartesian order, enclosing-domain scope and repeated generator shadowing through both entry paths.

C2.test: comprehensions skip excluded domains and keep generated payloads lazy
assertions: if false for y in error 'domain'
C2.checks: Seven exact-value cases via forms_value cover skipped domains, lazy array bodies, selected elements, empty/null keys and an unneeded error-valued iterator.

C3.test: comprehension shape constructs keys before forcing cached selected bodies
C3.checks: Shape constructs two keys; repeated selected field body executes once, other/null-key bodies execute zero times.

C4.test: duplicate and invalid comprehension keys fail before any body callbacks
C4.checks: Both parsed source and exported AST create successfully, then duplicate/nonstring key construction fails as Runtime/Type; counters prove 2/1 key calls and zero bodies.

C5.test: nonboolean comprehension filters reject before later native domains
C5.checks: Array/object invalid filters reject at evaluation through both entry paths, before any later native domain execution.

C6.test: comprehension fields inherit self super locals and root without freezing originals
C6.checks: forms_value checks original/derived comprehension locals using self/super and enclosing-self keys with root $ through parsed source and exported AST.

C7.test: comprehension key and filter errors remain runtime after valid parsing
C7.checks: forms_runtime creates each parsed/AST Program before asserting Runtime/Type and source file; exact key/body error markers distinguish demand sites. Controls skip invalid later numeric domains.

A1.test: handmade AST duplicate local groups reject ordinary and empty comprehension scopes
A1.checks: Four hand-built local/object/empty-comprehension/unused-branch ASTs reject duplicate groups at creation, without parser participation.

A2.test: handmade AST comprehension key and domain scope reject inaccessible bindings
A2.checks: Three hand-built ASTs reject a new object local in key scope and later-loop variables in earlier array/object domains.

A3.test: handmade AST recursive locals and null comprehension keys stay lazy
A3.checks: Hand-built forward local group yields 42; repeated null comprehension keys suppress the error body and yield an empty object.

A4.test: handmade AST dynamic duplicate keys are runtime and literal duplicates static
A4.checks: Hand-built comprehension creates successfully then rejects duplicate runtime keys; literal duplicate object fields reject before Program creation.

FINITE.test: P0 JSON manifestation rejects nonfinite internal values defensively
FINITE.checks: Direct internal +/-Inf/NaN fail both structured and string JSON output paths.

chk-self.remaining: All enclosing expression forms and public-AST combinations.

chk-super.remaining: Top-level/standalone super and every syntactic context not newly reviewed.

chk-object.remaining: Literal duplicate names, object-local recursion and statics in every assertion/value position.

chk-object-comp.remaining: Exhaustive key/domain/local scope cross-product and malformed comprehensions; only listed source and handmade AST cases reviewed.

chk-local.remaining: Every binder/initializer AST form, all mutually recursive structures and exhaustive object/comprehension nesting.

chk-apply.remaining: Every argument expression form; AST/source distinctions.

chk-var.remaining: All binders and unused expression positions.

chk-function.remaining: Every default/body AST form; parameter metadata is a separate host contract.

chk-import.remaining: Every import expression/string form and isolated std binding.

object.remaining: Computed null/nonstring/duplicate names, all object local forms.

object-comp.remaining: Exhaustive nested generators, all key scalar kinds and multiple failing key order; mechanical non-array domain extensions remain unadjudicated.

array-index.remaining: Exhaustive numeric/operator combinations and all target/key type failures.

object-index.remaining: Missing fields, invalid keys, multiple failing assertions, equality/assertion interactions.

apply.remaining: Non-function targets, all recursive closure forms and exhaustive tailstrict interactions.

local.remaining: All recursive group shapes and every desugared object/comprehension binding; the finite even/odd pair is a subset.

local-var.remaining: Capture avoidance across every binder and recursive expression.

object-inherit.remaining: Full algebra, additive nested fields, association with super and duplicate dynamic names.

length-array.remaining: Full length contract belongs to public-library matrix.

type-null.remaining: Outer demanded-error cases not assigned to this row.

type-boolean.remaining: Outer demanded-error cases not assigned to this row.

type-number.remaining: All finite/invalid producer boundaries are tracked separately.

type-string.remaining: All Unicode and demanded-string error boundaries.

type-array.remaining: All array-producing expressions and invalid outer errors.

manifest-value.remaining: Exact preservation of every scalar kind/Unicode sequence and finite extreme.

manifest-object.remaining: Cycles, field-order independence, all nested hidden/visible errors and std.manifestJson distinctions.

manifest-array.remaining: Cycles, every nested shape and resource-independent evaluation boundaries.
